description: This file defines an Android Fragment class 'LogFragment' which contains a LogView and manages its display and scrolling behavior to show log data within an app.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment encapsulating a custom LogView, providing log display functionality with automatic scrolling.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the view hierarchy containing a ScrollView and a LogView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Android lifecycle method that inflates views and sets up a text change listener to auto-scroll.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
